observations: Fiscal years end 30 June; year = FY end (FY24 = Jul 2023-Jun 2024). Site-level data only for FY24; FY20 is an "adjusted baseline" and FY21-FY24 reflect the asset portfolio held in each year (footnote A16), so the company series is not like-for-like.

Total withdrawal more than doubled: 11,088 ML (FY20) -> 12,752 (FY21) -> 20,016 (FY22, Ernest Henry acquired) -> 18,777 (FY23) -> 23,198 ML (FY24, Northparkes included for full 12 months per NGER). Growth is driven by mine dewatering groundwater (3,034 -> 13,089 ML). Municipal water jumped from 198 to 1,939 ML in FY24 (Northparkes 1,727 ML).

Withdrawal intensity 0.74 (FY20) -> 0.81 kL/t (FY24) while raw-water intensity fell 0.40 -> 0.22 kL/t, beating the FY24 target of 0.34 kL/t (0.40 adjusted for Northparkes) per TNFD index C16. Target: year-on-year reduction of raw water per dry tonne milled vs adjusted FY20 baseline.

Discharge table is labelled in kL, but values are clearly ML-scale (Red Lake 1,968 of 2,565 ML withdrawn). Recorded without conversion (as ML) and flagged in each note - verify against the Annual & Sustainability Report. The first row "Water Discharged to Fresh Water Bodies" is actually total discharge (sum of all destinations incl. dust suppression on land).

"Total Water Used" under GRI 303-5 (Water consumption) equals total withdrawal in every column; no true consumption figure is disclosed. Reuse % exceeds 100% at Cowal (179%) and Northparkes (164%) because it is reuse divided by withdrawal. Company reuse rate fell from 93% (FY21) to 76% (FY24).
No facilities in water-stressed areas in any year (all sites "No"), based on ICMM/CEO Water Mandate/WRI Aqueduct/WFN-adapted definition.

Compliance: FY24 two monetary fines >US$10k (one water-related, one biodiversity-related; administrative non-compliances at Cowal, ~A$18,800 each); an environment protection order was issued to Mt Rawdon for a late-2022 non-compliance involving release of water after an unseasonal rainfall event (GRI index G51). Moderate environmental incidents: 8 (FY20), 4, 1, 1, 2 (FY24). Significant spill volumes (kL): 13 (FY20), 10, 45, 6, 0 (FY24).
Production footnote: includes toll treatment at Ernest Henry, EKJV at Mungari and 100% Northparkes for full FY24 - differs from equity production. Copper and GEO only reported for FY23-FY24.
